subject: India tiered eKYC
summary: OTP-based e-KYC accounts capped (INR 1 lakh balance, INR 2 lakh credits a year, one year to complete full CDD); V-CIP controls; CKYCR upload within 10 days. No URL cited in banking-ops notes.

subject: UK VRP
summary: Commercial VRP scheme run by UKPI live from 2 Jun 2026 (wave 1: regulated financial services, government, utilities, rail); layered on OBL APIs and settled over FPS. No URL cited in banking-ops notes.

subject: US Section 1033
summary: Rule on the books but enjoined and under reconsideration; model integrations as contractual/FDX-based.

subject: Payment sanctions screening
summary: OFAC SDN blocking, 50% rule, 10-business-day reporting; EU Instant Payments Regulation daily customer screening against EU sanctions lists instead of per-transaction screening.

subject: EU instant payment timeouts
summary: If the 10-second maximum cannot be met, the payer PSP must immediately restore the payer's account.

subject: Nostro/vostro entries and card clearing
summary: Bank A's INR account at Bank C is A's nostro and C's vostro; Bank C credits via its settlement account at the central bank.
